resources.string: UTF-8 CSV, up to 10 MiB and 10,000 rows. Generic header: date,amount,direction,merchant,category,reference. Use positive INR amounts and DEBIT/CREDIT. Quoted commas, newlines and doubled quotes are supported.
The selected file is read for this preview only. Preview and cancel write no transactions. No original file or permanent file access is retained.
Refresh preview and clear review choices

Debit and credit describe balance movement. Confirm clear debits as expenses or review rows individually. Credits, unknown categories and possible matches need review. Excluded or unresolved rows will not be imported.
This applies only to valid, unmatched debit rows with a known category. Credits and possible duplicates stay in review.
Choose a category; the file value is unknown, archived or ambiguous.
Possible existing movement. Match it or explicitly confirm a separate event. Identical rows within this file remain separate occurrences.
Create a separate event despite the possible match

Account: %1$s. Accepted rows: %2$d. New transactions: %3$d. Matches to existing transactions: %4$d. Unaccepted rows stay excluded. The accepted subset reserves this file identity; use a corrected or reduced file for additional rows.
No CSV batches have been committed.

Undo soft-deletes only unchanged transactions created by this batch and detaches its evidence from existing transactions. Edits or new links block the whole action. Restore is explicit and also checks for changes.
The accepted selections conflict with ledger rules. Review refunds, transfer accounts and repeated matches before committing.
Could not read this CSV. Check UTF-8 encoding, quote structure, unique column headers and the size/row/field limits.
The file exceeds 10,000 data records. Blank records also count toward the limit.
Save the file as UTF-8. Other encodings are not guessed.
Quotes must enclose a whole field; escape a quote by doubling it.
Headers must be unique and nonempty, with at most 100 characters each.
Choose an active account and distinct required columns. Optional columns can be left absent. Dates must use the selected format.
The operation could not be completed. Your ledger has not been partially imported. Review selections or retry after refreshing.
The ledger changed. Refresh the preview or reopen the history action before confirming.
This file was already committed, even if the mapping or account changes. Open its batch in history. For additional rows, choose a corrected or reduced file.
This file belongs to an undone batch. Restore it explicitly from history; importing again will not recreate its transactions.
Batch records were edited, deleted, restored or acquired new links. Nothing changed. Open Review linked transactions to inspect the affected records.
CSV batch undone. Replay identity is retained.
column count does not match the header
invalid date for the selected format
use one positive plain amount with at most two decimal places
direction must be DEBIT or CREDIT
merchant, category or reference exceeds its length limit
